items.title_en: Trump Announces Greenland Deal, Will Deploy Large Troops and Claim "Permanent Security Control"
paras: 《CNBC》報導，美國總統川普週五 (18 日) 宣布，美國已與格陵蘭及丹麥達成安全協議，將在格陵蘭適當地點建立大規模軍事部署，並取得他所稱的「永久安全控制權」。不過，格陵蘭與丹麥尚未證實協議已經達成，相關正式文本也尚未公布。
川普在自家社群平台 Truth Social 發文表示，美國將立即啟動程序，在格陵蘭合適地區擴大軍事存在。他聲稱，這項安排涵蓋美國所有關切，且不會讓美國承擔任何費用。
根據川普說法，協議將讓美國永久掌控格陵蘭的安全及其他需求。但從目前披露的內容來看，這項安排與他先前主張將格陵蘭納入美國領土的立場仍有明顯差距。
格陵蘭是丹麥自治領地，美國早已依據與丹麥簽訂的數十年期防務協議，在當地部署軍事力量。格陵蘭政府先前一再強調該島「非賣品」，歐盟今年稍早也曾聯合反對川普收購格陵蘭的主張。
儘管如此，川普對新協議表示滿意，稱相關安排已解決美國的全部關切。
截稿前，格陵蘭與丹麥均未立即回應川普的說法。
paras_en: CNBC reported that U.S. President Donald Trump announced on Friday (the 18th) that the United States has reached a security agreement with Greenland and Denmark to establish a large‑scale military deployment at appropriate locations in Greenland and to obtain what he calls "permanent security control." However, Greenland and Denmark have not confirmed that an agreement has been reached, and the official text has not been released.

Trump posted on his own social platform, Truth Social, that the United States will immediately begin procedures to expand its military presence in suitable areas of Greenland. He claimed the arrangement covers all U.S. concerns and will not cost the United States anything.

According to Trump, the agreement will give the United States permanent control over Greenland’s security and other needs. But based on the limited details disclosed so far, the arrangement still falls short of his earlier stance of annexing Greenland as U.S. territory.

Greenland is an autonomous territory of Denmark, and the United States has long deployed forces there under a multi‑decade defense pact with Denmark. The Greenlandic government has repeatedly stressed that the island is "not for sale," and the European Union earlier this year jointly opposed Trump’s proposal to purchase Greenland.
Nevertheless, Trump said he was satisfied with the new agreement, stating that the arrangement resolves all of America’s concerns.
At the time of submission, neither Greenland nor Denmark had responded immediately to Trump’s statements.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Four-Quarter Day Volatility, Chip Stocks Support, Philly Semiconductor Index Up Nearly 3%, Dow Weekly Decline Largest in Six Months
paras: 美股週五 (18 日) 漲跌互見，人工智慧 (AI) 題材仍具動能，帶動標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數小幅收高，費半指數高升近3%。道瓊則下跌近百點，10 年期美債殖利率重返 5% 附近，加上國際油價仍處每桶 100 美元以上，持續壓抑市場風險偏好。
那斯達克指數本週上漲約 0.7%，標普 500 指數下跌約 0.1%。道瓊則重挫約 1.7%，寫下 3 月以來最大單週跌幅。
美股週五適逢衍生性金融商品到期的「四巫日」，約有名目價值 7 兆美元的選擇權到期，推升成交量並加劇盤中波動。不過，美債殖利率再度攀升，壓抑美股進一步上攻。
10 年期美債殖利率週五一度升約 5.9 個基點至 5.006%，收在 4.995%。交易員提高 Fed 10 月再次升息的押注，反映市場仍擔憂能源價格上漲可能讓通膨持續承壓。
Fed 本週以 12 比 0 一致通過升息 1 碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至 3.75% 至 4%，為逾 3 年來首次升息。Fed 最新經濟預測與主席華許的談話均顯示，央行仍把抑制通膨列為政策重點。
國際油價週五連續第三個交易日下降，但仍維持在每桶 100 美元以上。市場預期沙烏地阿拉伯可能在數日內恢復東西向輸油管線約一半運能，緩解供應中斷疑慮。沙國也透過阿曼蘇哈爾港外的船對船轉運，向亞洲煉油商提供額外原油。
美伊外交進展也受到關注。美國總統川普本週表示，希望戰爭已接近尾聲，並稱伊朗非常希望達成協議。美國國務院據傳已向伊朗總統及外交部長等官員核發簽證，讓他們出席下週在紐約舉行的聯合國大會。
美股週五 (18 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 2.43%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.26%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.64%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 0.80%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.00%。
費城半導體族群多收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 2.70%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 2.97%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 1.34%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 強漲 6.51%；高通 (QCOM-US) 重挫 5.82%。
記憶體類股全線走揚。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 3.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 4.13%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 大漲 10.99%；希捷 (STX-US) 強漲 6.93%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 2.46%。

企業新聞
波克夏·海瑟威董事長巴菲特將卸下董事長職務，由其子霍華德·巴菲特接任，為這家綜合企業長達 60 多年的巴菲特時代再畫下一個句點。巴菲特將轉任榮譽董事長並繼續擔任董事。波克夏·海瑟威 B 股 (BRK.B-US) 上漲 0.1% 至每股 509.77 美元。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收低 0.26% 至每股 336.13 美元，週線收高0.57%。iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max週五在台灣及全球多個國家與地區正式開賣，這是特納斯接任執行長後推出的首批新款iPhone。受到AI需求推升全球記憶體與儲存裝置成本影響，兩款Pro機型起售價均較前代調高100美元，分別為1,199美元及1,299美元。
Steel Dynamics (STLD-US) 與紐柯鋼鐵 (NUE-US) 分別下跌 4.11%和 6.32%。儘管美國鋼價過去 12 個月大幅上漲，兩家公司公布的會計年度第三季財測仍令華爾街失望。
Netflix (NFLX-US) 下跌 4.7%，收每股 71.79 美元。富國銀行以用戶參與度下降、缺乏大型原創影集為由，將 Netflix 投資評等調降至「減碼」，並把目標價由 80 美元下修至 57 美元，成為數月來首家看空該公司的券商。
隨著比特幣價格反彈，加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase (COIN-US) 暴漲近 12%，網路交易平台 Robinhood (HOOD-US) 飛升 9.12%，加密資產投資公司 Strategy (MSTR-US) 更飆升逾 16%。投資人未受聯準會 (Fed) 升息及《CLARITY法案》功敗垂成影響。
外媒報導，人工智慧新創公司 Anthropic 已告知投資人，預計今年底前取得約 5 GW 的運算能力，在推進首次公開募股 (IPO) 計畫之際加快擴張腳步。
華爾街分析
Edward Jones 高級投資策略師 Angelo Kourkafas 表示，Fed 最新升息不太可能是一次性行動，但也不像新一輪激進升息週期的開端。在他看來，Fed 目前並未像 2022 年那樣嚴重落後於通膨情勢。
摩根大通執行長戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 對通膨前景保持謹慎，表示目前仍無法確定通膨是否已受到控制，凸顯市場對一次升息能否有效壓低物價仍存疑慮。
Janney Montgomery Scott 投資長 Mark Luschini 表示，距離財報季仍有一段時間，Fed政策前景也已較為明朗，市場目前缺乏推動股市再創新高的新催化劑。若美國與伊朗關係緩和並帶動油價持續回落，則可能降低能源成本的外溢效應與地緣政治風險溢價，成為股市短期上漲動力。
Certuity 投資長 Scott Welch 預期 Fed 可能在 10 月或選舉後至少再升息一次，2027 年也可能再升息一至兩次。美債殖利率仍面臨上行壓力，油價未來幾個月也可能維持高檔。雖然他並未看空股市，但預期市場今年剩餘時間可能維持緩步前進的格局。

paras_en: U.S. stocks on Friday (the 18th) were mixed, with AI themes still providing momentum, nudging the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indices slightly higher while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged almost 3%. The Dow slipped close to 100 points as the 10‑year Treasury yield returned to around 5% and international oil prices stayed above $100 a barrel, continuing to suppress market risk appetite.
The Nasdaq rose about 0.7% this week, the S&P 500 fell roughly 0.1%, and the Dow plunged about 1.7%, marking its biggest weekly drop since March.

Friday’s market coincided with the “quadruple‑witching” day when derivative contracts expire, with about $7 trillion of options expiring, boosting volume and heightening intraday swings. However, rising Treasury yields dampened further upside in U.S. equities.

The 10‑year Treasury yield spiked to about 5.006% on Friday, up roughly 5.9 basis points, before closing at 4.995%. Traders increased bets that the Fed will raise rates again in October, reflecting lingering worries that higher energy prices could keep inflation pressure alive.

The Fed this week unanimously voted 12‑0 to raise its target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4%, its first hike in more than three years. The latest Fed economic forecasts and Chair Powell’s remarks both underscore that curbing inflation remains the central policy focus.

International oil prices fell for the third consecutive trading day on Friday but stayed above $100 a barrel. Markets expect Saudi Arabia may restore about half the capacity of its east‑west pipelines within days, easing supply‑disruption concerns, and the kingdom is also using ship‑to‑ship transfers off Oman’s Suhar port to supply extra crude to Asian refiners.

U.S.–Iran diplomatic developments also drew attention. President Trump said this week he hopes the war is nearing its end and claimed Iran is eager to reach an agreement. Reports say the State Department has issued visas to Iran’s president and foreign minister so they can attend next week’s UN General Assembly in New York.
U.S. market performance on Friday (the 18th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 95.40 points, or 0.18%, to 51,682.64. The Nasdaq gained 104.25 points, or 0.40%, to 26,522.55. The S&P 500 rose 12.74 points, or 0.17%, to 7,650.50. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 322.19 points, or 2.78%, to 11,921.69. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 28.19 points, or 0.15%, to 18,806.08.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, performance was mixed: Meta (META‑US) down 2.43%; Apple (AAPL‑US) down 0.26%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) up 0.64%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) down 0.80%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) up 1.00%.

The Philadelphia semiconductor group posted broad gains: AMD (AMD‑US) up 2.70%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) up 2.97%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) up 1.34%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) surged 6.51%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) plunged 5.82%.
Memory stocks rallied across the board: Micron (MU‑US) up 3.92%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) up 4.13%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) surged 10.99%; Seagate (STX‑US) jumped 6.93%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) up 2.46%.
All Taiwan ADRs closed higher: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 1.02%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 4.10%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 0.57%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 0.39%.
Corporate news

Berkshire Hathaway’s chairman Warren Buffett will step down as chairman, with his son Howard Buffett taking over, marking the end of the Buffett era at the conglomerate after more than 60 years. Warren will become executive chairman and remain on the board. Berkshire Hathaway B shares (BRK.B‑US) rose 0.1% to $509.77.

Apple (AAPL‑US) fell 0.26% to $336.13, while the weekly chart was up 0.57%. The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max went on sale Friday in Taiwan and many other markets, the first new iPhone models launched under CEO Tony Fadell. Due to AI‑driven demand raising global memory and storage costs, both Pro models start $100 higher than their predecessors, at $1,199 and $1,299 respectively.

Steel Dynamics (STLD‑US) and Nucor (NUE‑US) fell 4.11% and 6.32% respectively. Despite a sharp rise in U.S. steel prices over the past year, the third‑quarter fiscal‑year outlooks from both companies disappointed Wall Street.

Netflix (NFLX‑US) dropped 4.7% to $71.79. Wells Fargo downgraded Netflix to “underweight,” citing declining user engagement and a lack of major original series, cutting the price target from $80 to $57, making it the first bearish rating on the stock in months.

As Bitcoin rebounded, cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase (COIN‑US) surged nearly 12%, trading platform Robinhood (HOOD‑US) jumped 9.12%, and crypto‑investment firm MicroStrategy (MSTR‑US) rose over 16%. Investors appear unfazed by the Fed’s rate hikes and the stalled CLARITY Act.
Foreign media reported that AI startup Anthropic told investors it expects to secure about 5 GW of compute capacity by year‑end, accelerating its expansion as it prepares for an IPO.
Wall Street analysis

Edward Jones senior investment strategist Angelo Kourkafas said the Fed’s latest hike is unlikely to be a one‑off move, but it also does not signal the start of a new aggressive‑tightening cycle. He believes the Fed is not as far behind inflation as it was in 2022.

JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon remains cautious on inflation, saying it is still unclear whether price pressures are truly under control, highlighting market doubts about the effectiveness of a single rate hike in lowering inflation.

Janney Montgomery Scott CIO Mark Luschini noted that earnings season is still some way off and the Fed policy outlook is clearer, leaving the market without a fresh catalyst to push stocks to new highs. He added that a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions and a continued decline in oil prices could reduce energy‑cost spillovers and geopolitical risk premiums, providing short‑term upside for equities.

Certainty CIO Scott Welch expects the Fed may raise rates again in October or at least once after the election, and possibly one or two more times in 2027. Treasury yields still face upside pressure and oil prices may stay elevated for months. While he is not bearish on equities, he foresees a modest, gradual market trajectory for the remainder of the year.
All figures are updated as of the deadline; please refer to actual market quotes for the latest numbers.

items.title: 馬斯克押注AI大爆發！估美國明年GDP成長翻倍至4%
items.title_en: Musk Bets on an AI Boom! Forecasts U.S. GDP Growth to Double to 4% Next Year
paras: 馬斯克(Elon Musk)看好人工智慧(AI)將在未來一年大幅推升美國經濟成長, 他預估AI可能讓美國明年GDP成長率從約2%提高至4%, 甚至不排除更高水準。馬斯克9月18日在社群平台X發文表示, 「我的猜測是, AI明年將讓美國GDP成長率大約翻倍, 從約2%升至4%, 甚至可能更高。」
這項預測正值市場激烈討論AI巨額基礎建設支出究竟能否轉化為整體經濟生產力之際。近年美國科技業投入晶片、資料中心及AI運算基礎設施的資金規模持續攀升, 但投資增加與生產力改善之間仍存在時間落差, 市場關注AI究竟需要多久才能從企業資本支出轉化為廣泛的經濟成長。
AI投資規模已相當可觀。Apollo Global Management首席經濟學家Torsten Slok估計, 美國AI相關資本支出占GDP的比重, 可能從3年前約0.6%提高至2027年至2029年平均約3%。此外, 穆迪分析師引述的數據顯示, 美國科技企業2027年在晶片及資料中心的支出可能接近1兆美元, 遠高於中國競爭對手預計的約1,650億美元。
如此龐大的資本支出將直接帶動經濟活動, 但真正決定AI能否支撐4%經濟成長的關鍵, 並不是投入多少資金, 而是這些投資能否轉化為足夠的生產力提升。如果企業能夠利用生成式AI及AI代理人提高每名員工的產出, AI帶來的經濟效益可能比過去的科技週期更快出現。
目前生成式AI已逐漸進入軟體開發、研究、客服及其他商業流程, 企業也開始使用能夠自主執行多步驟工作的AI代理人。若相關工具能夠快速提高勞動生產力, AI對GDP的貢獻可能在短時間內擴大。
不過, 歷史經驗顯示, 科技投資激增與整體經濟生產力改善之間往往存在明顯落差。1990年代網際網路基礎建設快速擴張後, 美國企業仍花費多年時間調整商業流程及資本配置, 生產力提升才逐步反映在整體經濟數據中。因此, AI是否能在短短一年內將GDP成長率推升至4%, 仍取決於企業採用速度及生產力改善幅度。
從目前的經濟預測來看, 馬斯克的4%目標與主流預期存在明顯差距。Morningstar預期美國經濟成長將一路放緩至2027年, 而非加速至馬斯克所預估的4%。此外, 利率環境也是影響AI投資擴散的重要因素。美聯儲9月16日將基準利率升至4%, 而高盛則預期10月可能再次升息。
較高的利率未必會阻止大型科技企業持續投入AI基礎建設, 但可能提高中小型企業導入AI技術的融資成本。大型企業擁有較充裕的現金流及資本市場融資能力, 可以繼續建置資料中心與運算設備; 相較之下, 規模較小的企業若必須透過借貸或其他外部融資導入AI, 可能受到高利率環境的限制。
另一方面, 美國消費市場目前仍展現一定韌性。美國8月零售銷售較7月增加1.2%, 高於市場預期的0.8%; 核心零售銷售則增加1.4%, 同樣高於原先預估的0.6%。消費持續成長意味著AI投資之外, 美國經濟仍有其他支柱提供支持。
AI對美國經濟的實際貢獻目前已經開始出現在GDP數據中。摩根大通資產管理的分析顯示, 美國超大規模雲端企業今年資本支出可能接近8,000億美元, 約為2019年的10倍。該機構估算, 過去一年AI相關投資約貢獻美國實質GDP成長0.47個百分點, 約占2.1%實質GDP成長速度的五分之一。
不過, AI投資對GDP的實際影響可能受到進口硬體的抵銷。美國許多AI伺服器、晶片及相關設備依賴海外製造, 因此部分投資支出會在GDP計算中被進口項目抵銷。摩根大通指出, 美國超大規模雲端企業約30%的資本支出流向海外資料中心, 同時部分AI硬體進口也會降低相關投資對美國GDP的直接貢獻。
美聯儲研究人員也指出, AI對經濟的影響應從技術能力與成本、企業投資與採用, 以及生產力和勞動市場等不同面向觀察。AI技術能力提升與成本下降通常先發生, 接著才是企業廣泛採用及增加投資, 最終才可能反映在整體生產力與勞動市場數據中。
美國財政部相關分析則指出, AI投資近年已成為經濟成長的重要推動力量。2025年AI驅動的投資約占美國GDP成長的近30%, 而這項趨勢延續至2026年前兩季。不過, 財政部同時指出, AI帶來的生產力改善幅度及實現時間仍存在不確定性, 最終效果也可能取決於AI在服務業等領域的普及程度。
馬斯克的預測也與他自身企業利益存在關聯。其旗下特斯拉(Tesla, TSLA-US)持續布局自動駕駛、機器人與AI技術, 而xAI則直接投入生成式AI模型及運算基礎設施。因此, 路透社指出, 馬斯克看好AI快速推升經濟成長的預測, 與其旗下企業持續擴大AI相關業務存在明顯關聯, 不過他在X上的相關發文並未揭露這些利益關係。
AI基礎建設支出目前也正在形成一個龐大的資本循環。輝達(NVIDIA, NVDA-US)等晶片企業受惠於AI運算需求, 雲端服務商則持續擴建資料中心, 同時電力、網路設備、記憶體及半導體製造商也需要增加產能以滿足AI供應鏈需求。這些投資可以在短期內刺激固定資本形成, 但能否最終轉化為更高的勞動生產力, 才是決定AI是否能帶動長期GDP成長的核心因素。
目前市場對AI經濟效應的爭論, 因此已從「AI是否會帶來成長」逐漸轉向「成長幅度有多大以及何時出現」。摩根大通的數據顯示, AI相關投資目前確實已對美國GDP成長提供一定貢獻, 美國財政部也將AI投資列為近期經濟成長的重要來源, 但兩者都未支持短期內GDP成長率必然達到4%的結論。
對投資人而言, 接下來企業財報及資本支出計畫將成為觀察AI經濟效益的重要指標。若企業開始在財報中揭露AI導入帶來的成本下降、營收增加或員工生產力提升, 將有助於判斷AI投資是否已從單純的基礎建設支出, 進一步轉化為廣泛的經濟生產力。
因此, 馬斯克提出的4% GDP成長預測, 本質上是對AI生產力革命速度的高度樂觀判斷。目前美國AI投資規模已達前所未有的水準, 但從投資轉化為實質生產力仍需要時間。未來一年企業AI採用速度、資本支出規模、勞動生產力及整體消費需求, 將決定這項預測能否逐步在經濟數據中得到驗證。
paras_en: Elon Musk is bullish that artificial intelligence (AI) will dramatically boost the U.S. economy within the next year, estimating that AI could lift next year’s GDP growth rate from about 2% to 4%, and possibly even higher. In a post on X on September 18, Musk wrote, “My guess is AI will roughly double U.S. GDP growth next year, from about 2% to 4%, and maybe even more.”

This forecast comes amid heated market debate over whether massive AI infrastructure spending can translate into overall economic productivity. In recent years, U.S. tech firms have steadily increased capital for chips, data centers and AI computing infrastructure, but a lag remains between spending and productivity gains, prompting the market to wonder how long it will take for AI to turn corporate cap‑ex into broad economic growth.

AI investment is already sizable. Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, estimates that AI‑related capital spending could rise from roughly 0.6% of GDP three years ago to an average of about 3% between 2027 and 2029. Moody’s analysts cite data showing U.S. tech firms may spend close to $1 trillion on chips and data centers in 2027, far above China’s projected $165 billion.

Such massive cap‑ex will directly spur economic activity, but the key to whether AI can sustain 4% growth is not the amount of money spent, but whether those investments translate into sufficient productivity gains. If firms can use generative AI and AI agents to boost output per employee, the economic benefits of AI could appear faster than in previous tech cycles.

Generative AI is already making inroads into software development, research, customer service and other business processes, and firms are beginning to deploy AI agents that can autonomously execute multi‑step tasks. If these tools quickly raise labor productivity, AI’s contribution to GDP could expand in a short period.

However, historical experience shows a noticeable gap between surges in tech investment and overall productivity improvement. After the rapid expansion of internet infrastructure in the 1990s, U.S. companies took many years to adjust business processes and capital allocation before productivity gains showed up in macro data. Thus, whether AI can lift GDP growth to 4% within a single year still depends on adoption speed and the magnitude of productivity gains.

Current economic forecasts place Musk’s 4% target well above mainstream expectations. Morningstar projects U.S. growth to keep slowing through 2027 rather than accelerating to Musk’s level. The interest‑rate environment also matters: the Fed raised its benchmark rate to 4% on September 16, and Goldman Sachs expects another hike in October.

Higher rates may not stop large tech firms from continuing AI infrastructure spending, but they could raise financing costs for small‑ and mid‑size companies adopting AI. Big firms have ample cash flow and capital‑market access to keep building data centers and compute equipment; smaller firms that need to borrow or seek external financing may be constrained by the high‑rate environment.

On the other hand, the U.S. consumer market still shows resilience. August retail sales rose 1.2% from July, beating the 0.8% forecast, while core retail sales increased 1.4%, also above the 0.6% estimate. Ongoing consumer growth means that, beyond AI spending, other pillars continue to support the economy.

AI’s tangible contribution to the U.S. economy is already appearing in GDP figures. JPMorgan Asset Management analysis shows that the nation’s ultra‑large cloud providers may spend close to $800 billion on cap‑ex this year, about ten times the 2019 level. The firm estimates that AI‑related investment contributed roughly 0.47 percentage points to real GDP growth over the past year, about one‑fifth of the 2.1% real‑GDP growth rate.

Nevertheless, the impact of AI spending on GDP may be offset by imported hardware. Many U.S. AI servers, chips and related equipment are manufactured abroad, so part of the spending is offset by imports in the GDP calculation. JPMorgan notes that about 30% of ultra‑large cloud providers’ cap‑ex flows to overseas data centers, and imported AI hardware also reduces the direct contribution of those investments to U.S. GDP.

Federal Reserve researchers also stress that AI’s economic effect should be examined from multiple angles: technology capability and cost, corporate investment and adoption, and productivity and labor‑market outcomes. Typically, improvements in AI capability and cost reductions occur first, followed by broader corporate adoption and increased investment, and only later may these translate into higher productivity and labor‑market data.

Analyses from the U.S. Treasury indicate that AI investment has become a major driver of growth in recent years. By 2025, AI‑driven investment could account for nearly 30% of U.S. GDP growth, a trend that is expected to continue through the first two quarters of 2026. However, the Treasury also cautions that the magnitude and timing of AI‑induced productivity gains remain uncertain, and the ultimate effect may hinge on AI’s penetration in services and other sectors.

Musk’s forecast is also linked to his own corporate interests. Tesla (TSLA‑US) continues to expand autonomous‑driving, robotics and AI technologies, while his xAI venture is directly investing in generative‑AI models and compute infrastructure. Reuters notes that Musk’s optimism about AI rapidly boosting growth aligns with his companies’ expanding AI businesses, though his X posts did not disclose these conflicts of interest.

AI infrastructure spending is creating a massive capital cycle. Chip makers such as NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) benefit from AI compute demand, cloud providers keep expanding data centers, and power, networking, memory and semiconductor manufacturers must increase capacity to meet AI supply‑chain needs. These investments can stimulate fixed‑capital formation in the short term, but whether they ultimately translate into higher labor productivity is the core question for long‑term GDP growth.

The market debate over AI’s economic impact has shifted from “Will AI drive growth?” to “How large will the growth be and when will it materialize?” JPMorgan data show that AI‑related investment is already contributing to U.S. GDP growth, and the Treasury lists AI spending as a near‑term growth source, yet neither supports the conclusion that GDP growth will inevitably reach 4% in the short run.

For investors, upcoming corporate earnings and cap‑ex plans will be key gauges of AI’s economic payoff. If firms begin to disclose cost reductions, revenue gains or employee‑productivity improvements tied to AI in their reports, it will help assess whether AI spending is moving beyond pure infrastructure to broader productivity gains.

Thus, Musk’s 4% GDP‑growth projection essentially reflects an extremely optimistic view of the speed of an AI‑driven productivity revolution. While U.S. AI investment has reached unprecedented levels, converting that spending into real productivity will still take time. Over the next year, the pace of corporate AI adoption, the scale of cap‑ex, labor productivity and overall consumer demand will determine whether the forecast can gradually be validated in the data.

items.title: 矽谷銀行倒閉不是突發事件？外部報告：Fed早就該知道有風險
items.title_en: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse Was Not a Sudden Event? External Report Says the Fed Should Have Known the Risks Earlier
paras: 一份針對2023年矽谷銀行(SVB)倒閉事件的外部調查報告指出，聯準會(Fed)監管人員在危機爆發前「已經知道，或理應知道」該銀行存在重大脆弱性，顯示Fed可能錯失提早介入並防止擠兌的機會。
Fed監管副主席鮑曼周五(18日)在倫敦發表演說時，公布顧問公司Starling Advisory Group進行的調查結果。這份新報告對Fed監管失誤的批評，比2023年由時任監管副主席巴爾(Michael Barr)主持的內部檢討更加嚴厲。
矽谷銀行2023年3月宣布出售證券並認列18億美元損失，同時表示需要籌集更多資本，消息隨即引發大規模擠兌。該行持有大量美國公債，在Fed展開升息後，相關債券市值大幅下滑。
鮑曼引述報告指出，矽谷銀行高達94%的存款不受存款保險保障，而且高度集中於獲創投資金支持的科技公司。這種存款結構使該行格外容易受到恐慌提款衝擊。擠兌發生後，美國聯邦存款保險公司(FDIC)與Fed介入關閉銀行，並採取措施保障存戶資金。
巴爾2023年主持的檢討曾認定，Fed監管人員在處理矽谷銀行問題時過度謹慎，未能及時採取強硬措施。最新外部報告則更進一步，認為監管人員早在危機發生前，就已掌握或應該能辨識相關風險。
巴爾於2025年2月卸下監管副主席職務，讓美國總統川普選擇新的Fed最高監管官員，但仍保留Fed理事職位。川普其後提名鮑曼接任，並獲參議院通過。
新報告可能引發外界重新檢視巴爾在矽谷銀行危機中的責任，儘管鮑曼在演說中並未直接點名批評他。川普此前曾指控Fed理事會對他抱持「敵意」，部分分析師認為，這份報告可能促使川普嘗試將巴爾逐出Fed理事會。Fed發言人尚未回應置評要求。
paras_en: An external investigation report on the 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) states that Federal Reserve regulators "already knew, or should have known" about the bank’s significant vulnerabilities before the crisis erupted, indicating the Fed may have missed an opportunity to intervene early and prevent the run.

Fed regulatory vice‑chairman Bowman announced the findings of a study conducted by consulting firm Starling Advisory Group in a speech in London on Friday the 18th. The new report criticises the Fed’s regulatory failures more harshly than the internal review led by then‑deputy chair Michael Barr in 2023.

In March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank announced it was selling securities and taking an $1.8 billion loss, while also saying it needed to raise additional capital, a disclosure that immediately triggered a massive bank run. The bank held a large portfolio of U.S. Treasury bonds, whose market value fell sharply after the Fed began raising rates.

Bowman cited the report’s finding that 94 % of SVB’s deposits were uninsured and heavily concentrated among tech companies backed by venture capital. This deposit structure made the bank especially vulnerable to panic withdrawals. After the run began, the FDIC and the Fed stepped in to close the bank and took measures to protect depositors’ funds.

Barr’s 2023 review concluded that Fed regulators were overly cautious in handling SVB’s problems and failed to take decisive action in time. The latest external report goes further, asserting that regulators had either already identified or should have been able to identify the risks before the crisis unfolded.

Barr stepped down as deputy chair in February 2025, allowing President Trump to select a new top Fed regulator while Barr remained a Fed board member. Trump subsequently nominated Bowman to the position, and the Senate confirmed him.

The new report could prompt a renewed scrutiny of Barr’s responsibility for the SVB crisis, even though Bowman did not directly name him in his remarks. Trump has previously accused the Fed board of “hostility” toward him, and some analysts think the report may encourage Trump to try to oust Barr from the Fed board. A Fed spokesperson has not responded to requests for comment.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: 一年暴漲68% 美國柴油創歷史新高！農民成本暴增 食品價格恐跟著漲
items.title_en: Diesel in the U.S. Soars 68% in a Year, Hitting Record Highs – Farmers Face Rising Costs, Food Prices May Follow
paras: 美國柴油價格飆至歷史新高, 正在收割季節加重農民的燃料支出, 同時推升食品從農場到超市各環節的運輸成本。隨著美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事持續, 加上烏克蘭攻擊俄羅斯煉油設施造成全球成品油供應吃緊, 美國柴油均價本周升至每加侖6.29美元, 較一年前的3.74美元上漲68%, 創下歷史新高。
在密蘇里州東北部, 玉米、大豆及牛隻農民Addie Yoder目前正使用兩台聯合收割機、3輛半掛卡車及數台拖拉機, 從9月中旬一路忙到10月底進行農作物收割與運輸。她表示, 僅一台聯合收割機就需要約300加侖柴油, 在油價創新高之際, 農民能做的就是設法削減其他支出。
南達科他州東南部的大豆、玉米及牛隻農民Drew Peterson則估計, 本季僅為一台聯合收割機加滿燃料, 每天最高就要花費約1,500美元, 是去年的兩倍。由於農作物不能因為柴油昂貴就停止收割, 高昂燃料成本只能被納入整體農業預算。
柴油價格飆升正值美國農民本就面臨利潤空間有限之際。農業經濟學家Michael Langemeier表示, 玉米每英畝的燃料成本較去年增加11美元, 大豆則增加7美元。儘管玉米、大豆及小麥期貨自8月中旬以來明顯上漲, 並在9月初升至多年高點, 伊利諾大學農業經濟學家Nick Paulson指出, 農民利潤率相較歷史平均仍然偏低。
柴油價格對農業的影響不只停留在收割階段。農民需要柴油驅動拖拉機、聯合收割機及其他農業機械, 農產品收割後還需要透過卡車運往加工廠、倉庫及零售通路, 因此燃料成本上升會沿著整條食品供應鏈傳導。
密西根州立大學經濟學家David Ortega表示, 美國大部分食品都是透過卡車運輸, 而卡車主要使用柴油。這意味著柴油價格上升將增加從農場收割、食品加工、長途貨運到最終送達超市的各項成本。
目前食品通膨已經存在。美國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示, 食品價格年增2.7%。若柴油價格長時間維持在每加侖6美元以上, 農業及物流成本進一步上升, 食品價格可能面臨額外上行壓力。
柴油價格對農民而言雖有一定的稅務緩衝。農業使用的非公路柴油(off-road diesel)不需要負擔州及聯邦相關燃油稅, 但即使扣除這些稅負, 農民實際支付的燃料成本仍遠高於去年。
加州Gonzales附近、約600英畝土地上種植多種蔬菜的農民Wayne Gularte表示, 他的燃料成本已經上升約40%, 從每加侖約5美元提高至7美元。為降低支出, 他甚至重新啟用部分1950年代的老式汽油拖拉機, 並停用一輛柴油皮卡。
燃料成本上升也可能影響農民下一季的生產決策。Paulson表示, 每加侖6美元以上的柴油價格可能開始對其他農業投入成本形成通膨壓力, 包括種子與肥料等, 進而侵蝕近期農產品價格上漲可能帶來的部分利潤改善。
食品價格上漲的傳導速度則可能存在時間差。部分零售商可能選擇短期吸收成本增加, 物流業者與食品企業也可能受到既有運輸合約約束, 尚未立即將燃油成本轉嫁給客戶。因此, 柴油價格上升不一定會立即反映在超市貨架上的食品售價。
不過, 對需要冷藏運輸的食品而言, 成本壓力可能更加明顯。Ortega指出, 新鮮蔬果、乳製品及肉類等商品高度依賴冷藏卡車運輸, 因而更容易受到柴油價格上升影響。
物流成本已經開始出現明顯變化。從華盛頓州Yakima Valley運送蘋果與梨的冷藏拖車運費, 在當地收割季才進行一半的情況下, 已升至4年高點。DAT Freight & Analytics首席分析師Dean Croke表示, 從加州運輸農產品的成本較一年前上升40%至120%, 而加州部分城市的柴油價格甚至已突破每加侖8美元。
Croke指出, 獨立卡車業者通常需要先自行支付燃料費用, 因此若柴油價格進一步上升, 部分小型運輸企業可能難以承受成本壓力。他警告, 柴油價格推升的成本危機可能導致卡車運輸企業出現破產案例。
此次柴油價格上漲與全球能源供應緊張密切相關。美國與以色列對伊朗的戰事以及烏克蘭對俄羅斯煉油設施的攻擊, 同時壓縮全球成品油供應。美國全國柴油均價在9月10日首次突破每加侖6美元, 此後仍持續走高。
GasBuddy資料顯示, 美國柴油價格早在9月3日就已升至每加侖5.820美元, 超越2022年6月17日創下的每加侖5.819美元前高。柴油均價自7月15日以來一直維持在每加侖5美元以上, GasBuddy石油分析主管Patrick De Haan當時表示, 2026年可能成為美國史上柴油價格最高的一年。
柴油價格高漲也與原油價格突破每桶100美元有關。中東衝突導致全球原油供應面臨更大風險, 同時荷姆茲海峽航運量受到壓縮, 進一步增加能源市場的不確定性。9月初, Brent與WTI油價單周分別上漲7.6%及10%, 同期美國柴油價格也創下歷史紀錄。
近期油價雖然自高點回落, 但柴油市場的壓力並未同步消失。9月18日, 油價因沙烏地阿拉伯增加替代出口、中國介入外交斡旋以及市場對中東供應中斷的擔憂降溫而回落, 但原油仍維持在每桶100美元附近或以上。
此外, 美國柴油價格上升也可能增加整體通膨壓力, 使美聯儲面臨更加複雜的政策環境。美聯儲9月16日升息25個基點, 將聯邦基金利率目標區間提高至3.75%至4%, 市場同時開始評估10月進一步升息的可能性。Reuters報導指出, 市場目前定價10月再次升息的機率約為55.4%, 高於一周前的42.5%及一個月前的7.2%。
對食品市場而言, 柴油價格是否進一步推升物價, 將取決於高油價持續時間、農民是否能透過農產品價格轉嫁成本, 以及卡車運輸與零售業者吸收成本的能力。如果燃料價格長時間維持高檔, 目前集中在能源及運輸端的成本壓力可能逐步擴散至更多食品品項。
因此, 美國柴油價格創歷史新高不只是農民的燃料成本問題, 也可能成為食品通膨與物流成本的新一輪壓力來源。從農業機械、農產品運輸到冷藏物流, 柴油幾乎貫穿美國食品供應鏈各個環節, 而目前每加侖6美元以上的價格環境, 已讓農民與運輸業者必須重新調整成本結構。
paras_en: U.S. diesel prices have surged to a historic high, adding to farmers' fuel expenses during the harvest season and pushing up transportation costs at every stage from farm to supermarket. With the war between the United States and Israel against Iran ongoing and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries tightening global refined‑oil supplies, the average U.S. diesel price this week rose to $6.29 per gallon, up 68% from $3.74 a year ago, a record level.

In northeast Missouri, corn, soybean and cattle farmer Addie Yoder is currently using two combine harvesters, three semi‑trailer trucks and several tractors, working nonstop from mid‑September through the end of October to harvest and transport crops. She says a single combine alone consumes about 300 gallons of diesel, and with prices at a historic high the only thing farmers can do is try to cut other expenses.

Drew Peterson, a soybean, corn and cattle farmer in southeast South Dakota, estimates that fueling just one combine to full this season can cost as much as $1,500 per day, roughly double last year’s cost. Because crops cannot be left unharvested because diesel is expensive, the high fuel cost simply has to be absorbed into the overall farm budget.

The diesel price spike comes as U.S. farmers are already facing narrow profit margins. Agricultural economist Michael Langemeier notes that fuel costs per acre for corn have risen $11 compared with last year, and $7 for soybeans. Although corn, soybean and wheat futures have risen sharply since mid‑August and hit multi‑year highs in early September, University of Illinois agricultural economist Nick Paulson points out that farmer profit margins remain well below historical averages.

The impact of diesel prices on agriculture extends beyond the harvest. Farmers need diesel to run tractors, combines and other equipment, and after crops are harvested they must be trucked to processing plants, warehouses and retail outlets, so higher fuel costs ripple through the entire food supply chain.

David Ortega, an economist at Michigan State University, says most U.S. food is moved by trucks, which run primarily on diesel. This means that rising diesel prices will increase costs at every step—from farm harvest and food processing to long‑haul freight and final delivery to supermarkets.

Food inflation is already present. The U.S. Consumer Price Index for August showed food prices up 2.7% year‑over‑year. If diesel stays above $6 a gallon for an extended period, agricultural and logistics costs will climb further, putting additional upward pressure on food prices.

Diesel’s impact on farmers is somewhat softened by tax breaks. Off‑road diesel used in agriculture is exempt from state and federal fuel taxes, but even after those taxes are removed, farmers still pay fuel costs far higher than last year.

Wayne Gularte, a farmer near Gonzales, California, who grows a variety of vegetables on about 600 acres, says his fuel costs have risen roughly 40%, from about $5 per gallon to $7. To cut expenses, he has even re‑activated some 1950s‑era gasoline tractors and taken a diesel pickup out of service.

Higher fuel costs could also shape farmers’ decisions for the next season. Paulson says diesel prices above $6 a gallon may start to create inflationary pressure on other farm inputs such as seed and fertilizer, eroding some of the profit gains from recent commodity price increases.

The transmission of food‑price increases may be delayed. Some retailers may absorb higher costs in the short term, and logistics firms and food companies may be bound by existing transport contracts, so they may not immediately pass fuel cost hikes onto customers. Thus, diesel price rises do not necessarily show up right away on supermarket shelves.

However, for foods that require refrigerated transport, cost pressure may be more pronounced. Ortega notes that fresh produce, dairy and meat rely heavily on refrigerated trucks, making them especially vulnerable to higher diesel prices.

Logistics costs are already showing clear changes. Refrigerated trailer rates for moving apples and pears from Washington’s Yakima Valley have risen to a four‑year high even though the local harvest season is only halfway through. DAT Freight & Analytics chief analyst Dean Croke says the cost of moving agricultural products out of California has jumped 40% to 120% compared with a year ago, and diesel prices in some California cities have even topped $8 per gallon.

Croke adds that independent truck operators usually have to front the fuel expense themselves, so further diesel price hikes could overwhelm small transport firms. He warns that the cost crisis driven by diesel could lead to bankruptcies among trucking companies.

This diesel price surge is closely tied to global energy‑supply tightness. The U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries are both squeezing global refined‑oil supplies. The national average diesel price in the United States first broke $6 per gallon on September 10 and has kept climbing since.

GasBuddy data show U.S. diesel reached $5.820 per gallon on September 3, surpassing the previous high of $5.819 set on June 17 2022. The average has stayed above $5 per gallon since July 15, and GasBuddy’s oil‑analysis head Patrick De Haan said 2026 could become the year with the highest diesel prices in U.S. history.

The diesel surge is also linked to crude oil breaking $100 a barrel. Middle‑East conflicts have heightened risks to global oil supply, and reduced traffic through the Hormuz Strait has added further uncertainty to energy markets. In early September, Brent and WTI crude each jumped about 7.6% and 10% week‑over‑week, and U.S. diesel prices set new records at the same time.

Although oil prices have retreated from their peaks recently, diesel market pressure has not eased in step. On September 18, oil prices fell as Saudi Arabia increased alternative exports, China stepped in diplomatically and market worries over Middle‑East supply disruptions cooled, yet crude still hovered around $100 a barrel or higher.

Higher U.S. diesel prices could also add to overall inflation, complicating the Federal Reserve’s policy landscape. The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points on September 16, moving the federal‑funds target range to 3.75%–4%, and markets began pricing in a roughly 55.4% chance of another hike in October, up from 42.5% a week earlier and 7.2% a month earlier, according to Reuters.

Whether diesel will further push food prices depends on how long high oil prices persist, whether farmers can pass costs onto commodity prices, and how well trucking and retail firms can absorb the expense. If fuel stays high for a long stretch, cost pressure now concentrated in energy and transport could gradually spread to more food items.

Thus, the historic U.S. diesel high is not just a farmer fuel‑cost issue; it could become a new source of food‑inflation and logistics‑cost pressure. From farm machinery to product transport to refrigerated logistics, diesel runs through virtually every link in the American food supply chain, and the current environment of over $6 a gallon forces farmers and shippers to rethink their cost structures.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro漲100美元仍買氣熱！記憶體短缺、AI壓力考驗蘋果
items.title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Rises $100 Yet Demand Remains Strong; Memory Shortage and AI Pressure Test Apple
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max周五(18日)正式上市，這也是執行長特納斯(John Ternus)上任後首款推出的iPhone。同時，這也是蘋果首款在AI驅動的全球記憶體與儲存設備短缺環境下上市的新iPhone。
受到記憶體供應緊張影響，今年iPhone Pro系列價格較iPhone 17 Pro系列上調100美元。iPhone 18 Pro入門款售價為1,199美元，iPhone 18 Pro Max入門款則為1,299美元。(台灣售價分別為44,900及49,900元起)
可摺疊iPhone Duo預計於10月23日上市，售價將達1,999美元。(台灣售價為74,900元起)
儘管Duo受到市場高度關注，iPhone 18 Pro與iPhone 18 Pro Max同樣受到消費者熱烈追捧。
如果今天下單購買iPhone 18 Pro或iPhone 18 Pro Max，最快也要等待3周才能收到新機。
今年蘋果決定將iPhone 18系列拆分推出。不同於過去與Pro系列同步上市，蘋果預計將在明年初推出基本款iPhone 18，並同步推出iPhone 18e與iPhone Air 2。
Deepwater Asset Management管理合夥人Gene Munster周五在一份報告中指出，這種雙周期發布策略似乎有助於推動iPhone早期銷售。
他寫道，「我們的追蹤數據顯示，上市首日Pro機型的預購等待時間，比一年前長約15%。由於Duo將蠶食部分Pro系列需求，更長的等待時間顯示，部分原本可能購買iPhone 18的消費者轉而選擇Pro機型，抵銷了大部分Duo帶來的需求分流。」
iPhone 18 Pro系列與Duo均搭載升級版Apple Intelligence平台及AI驅動的Siri AI，儘管後者目前仍處於Beta測試階段。這套軟體對蘋果而言是一大步，因為公司正試圖扭轉外界認為其在消費型AI競賽中已經落後的觀感。
目前來看，Siri AI已展現相當實用的功能。在使用它詢問他人傳來的訊息和電子郵件內容，多數情況下，都能快速找出想知道的資訊，過程相當順暢。但由於仍處於Beta測試階段，目前偶爾還是會出現一些問題。
消費者將如何回應升級後的AI助理，將在很大程度上決定蘋果的AI布局是否走在正確的道路上。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Apple (AAPL-US) officially launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on Friday the 18th, marking the first iPhone released under CEO John Ternus. It is also Apple’s first new iPhone debuting amid a global AI‑driven memory and storage shortage.

Due to tight memory supplies, this year’s iPhone Pro lineup is priced $100 higher than the iPhone 17 Pro series. The base iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. (In Taiwan the prices start at NT$44,900 and NT$49,900 respectively.)
The foldable iPhone Duo is slated to launch on October 23, priced at $1,999. (In Taiwan the price starts at NT$74,900.)
Despite the Duo’s high market attention, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are also being chased enthusiastically by consumers.
If you place an order for an iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max today, the fastest delivery will still take about three weeks.

Apple has decided to stagger the iPhone 18 series rollout this year. Unlike previous years where the Pro models launched together with the base line, Apple plans to release the standard iPhone 18 early next year, alongside the iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2.
Gene Munster, managing partner at Deepwater Asset Management, noted in a Friday report that this dual‑cycle launch strategy appears to help drive early iPhone sales.

He wrote, “Our tracking data shows that the pre‑order wait time for Pro models on launch day is about 15% longer than a year ago. Because the Duo will cannibalize some Pro demand, the longer wait time indicates that some consumers who might have bought an iPhone 18 are shifting to the Pro models, offsetting most of the demand diversion caused by the Duo.”

Both the iPhone 18 Pro series and the Duo feature an upgraded Apple Intelligence platform and AI‑driven Siri AI, although the latter is still in beta testing. This software suite is a major step for Apple, which is trying to reverse the perception that it has fallen behind in the consumer AI race.

So far, Siri AI has shown quite practical capabilities. When used to query messages or email content from others, it usually retrieves the desired information quickly and smoothly. However, because it is still in beta, occasional glitches still occur.
How consumers respond to the upgraded AI assistant will largely determine whether Apple’s AI strategy is on the right track.

items.title: Anthropic IPO在即、估值上看2兆美元！世界真的準備好了嗎？
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Looms, Valuation at $2 Trillion! Is the World Really Ready?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，大多數CEO在IPO前的幾週裡，都會忙著向投資人路演推介、與投行一起制定策略，並對IPO招股說明書做最後的完善。而Anthropic的Dario Amodei卻把大量時間用來警告：人工智慧——這項他的公司參與開創的技術——可能帶來災難性的風險。
Amodei在接受CBS採訪時表示，「如果我們用錯誤的方式去構建它，發生糟糕事情的機率會非常高。」他還警告了多種風險，包括AI模型失控並發起網路攻擊（就像最近OpenAI的一組智慧體所做的那樣），以及人類濫用AI來製造生物武器。在這段24分鐘的採訪中，Anthropic的IPO一次都沒有被提及。
很快，這個話題將無法回避。Anthropic已於6月提交了保密的上市文件，公開申報材料預計隨時可能公布。據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic計劃通過此次IPO籌集高達1,000億美元的資金，這將使公司估值達到2兆美元。撇開申報文件不談，華爾街和Anthropic都還沒準備好迎接即將到來的局面。
Anthropic及其競爭對手已經打造出強大的AI模型，這些模型可能會不服從人類指令、突破安全隔離環境，並在現實世界造成嚴重破壞。Amodei和一眾同行一直在呼籲出台監管規則，以此約束產業發展。而與此同時，投資者卻在爭論這家公司究竟該值多少兆美元。
上週，Anthropic一名研究員Jacob Coxon因其所稱的AI進展速度不負責任而辭職。公司頂尖科學家Evan Hubinger隨後在社群媒體上發文，似乎促成了Amodei最近的一輪媒體密集發聲。
Hubinger寫道，「我們確實發自內心地相信，AI可能會殺死全人類！我個人認為，在未來十年內發生這種情況的機率超過10%。」
Amodei拒絕給出他自己對人類被毀滅機率的判斷，但他最近在接受CNN採訪時，談到那位已經離職的員工表示：「我同意Jacob的觀點遠多於不同意他的觀點。」
儘管投資界和其他科技公司高管很想把這些警告看作一種「反向心理」行銷手段，但Anthropic及其理想主義CEO的話應當被當真。股東價值未必永遠會是這家公司的首要考量。
Anthropic於2021年註冊為一家公益公司（PBC），其使命是追求「以負責任的方式開發和維護先進人工智慧，使其長期造福人類」。在特拉華州申請成為PBC並不會帶來稅收優惠，也不要求強制捐贈，亦不存在嚴格的執行機制。不過，PBC確實負有受託責任，需要在股東價值、其所宣示的使命以及員工和客戶等密切相關利益方的利益之間取得平衡。這種平衡機制能在公司把使命置於利潤之上時，為其抵禦股東訴訟提供保護。
在實踐中，這項法律例外可能意義不大，但Anthropic至少是在表明立場。自2023年以來，華爾街公開上市陣營中再未新增任何PBC，彼時各家公司還在宣揚其環境、社會和公司治理（ESG）方面的資質。
科羅拉多大學法學院教授Ann Lipton表示，「除了起到對外訊號傳遞的作用，我認為它沒有多大實際法律效力。它只是在提前告知市場：這就是我們打算做的事。」
社會使命與股票報酬通常很難兼容。《巴隆》梳理出16家以PBC身份上市，或在上市後轉為PBC的公司。其中，有12家上市之後的表現跑輸標普500指數。Anthropic還多了一層麻煩：體量巨大。正如《巴隆》5月報導的那樣，美國規模最大的IPO表現往往慘淡，因為它們的大部分增長早已成為過去，私募股東又急於套現離場。
僅僅決定是否投資一家以盈利為目標的公司，就已經夠難了；再疊加2兆美元的高估值，以及公司管理層自己都認為有可能毀滅世界的產品，Anthropic的IPO往最好的情況看，也是一場高風險押注。
讓Anthropic既令科幻愛好者感到心驚、又對投資者充滿吸引力的一點在於：AI革命確確實實正在發生。短短三年間，Anthropic的AI助手Claude已經從一款體驗欠佳的聊天機器人，進化成能夠編寫軟體程式、完成複雜任務、攻克曾經無解數學難題的系統。Claude模型在所有主要AI基準測試中排名居首或接近居首。
Amodei在1月份的一篇文章中寫道：按照這個發展速度，「用不了幾年，AI幾乎在所有事情上將都超越人類。」
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that most CEOs spend the weeks before an IPO road‑showing to investors, strategizing with banks, and polishing the prospectus. Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, however, has devoted much of his time to warning that artificial intelligence—the technology his company helped create—could pose catastrophic risks.

In a CBS interview Amodei said, “If we build it the wrong way, the chance of something terrible happening is very high.” He warned of several dangers, including AI models going rogue and launching cyber‑attacks (as a recent OpenAI swarm did) and humans misusing AI to create bioweapons. The 24‑minute interview never mentioned Anthropic’s IPO once.

The issue will soon be unavoidable. Anthropic filed a confidential registration statement in June, and the public filing could appear at any moment. The Wall Street Journal says the company plans to raise up to $100 billion in this IPO, which would value it at $2 trillion. Aside from the filing, neither Wall Street nor Anthropic seems ready for the coming scenario.

Anthropic and its rivals have built powerful AI models that could disobey human commands, break out of safety sandboxes and cause serious real‑world damage. Amodei and peers have been urging regulators to impose rules to curb the industry, while investors debate just how many trillions the company is worth.

Last week a researcher at Anthropic, Jacob Coxon, resigned, saying the pace of AI progress was irresponsible. Top scientist Evan Hubinger then posted on social media, seemingly prompting Amodei’s recent media blitz.
Hubinger wrote, “We truly believe AI could kill all of humanity! I personally think the probability of that happening within the next ten years exceeds 10%.”
Amodei declined to give his own estimate of humanity’s extinction risk, but in a recent CNN interview he said of the departed employee, “I agree with Jacob far more than I disagree.”

Even if investors and other tech CEOs want to treat these warnings as reverse‑psychology marketing, Anthropic’s idealistic CEO’s words should be taken seriously. Shareholder value may not always be the company’s top priority.

Anthropic incorporated in 2021 as a public benefit corporation (PBC) with the mission “to develop and maintain advanced AI responsibly, for the long‑term benefit of humanity.” Delaware’s PBC status offers no tax break, no mandatory donations and limited enforcement, but it does impose a fiduciary duty to balance shareholder interests with the declared mission and the interests of employees and customers, providing some protection against shareholder lawsuits when the mission trumps profit.

In practice the legal exception may matter little, but Anthropic at least signals a stance. Since 2023 no new PBC has joined Wall Street’s public‑company ranks, while firms continue to tout ESG credentials.
University of Colorado Law professor Ann Lipton said, “Beyond signaling to the market, I think it has little real legal effect. It’s simply a pre‑emptive notice of what we intend to do.”

Social missions and stock returns often clash. Baron identified 16 companies that went public as PBCs or converted afterward; 12 under‑performed the S&P 500 after listing. Anthropic adds another wrinkle: its massive size. As Baron reported in May, the biggest U.S. IPOs tend to perform poorly because most of their growth is already behind them and private shareholders are eager to cash out.

Deciding whether to invest in a profit‑driven company is already hard; add a $2 trillion valuation and a product that its own leadership thinks could destroy the world, and Anthropic’s IPO becomes, at best, a high‑risk bet.

What makes Anthropic both thrilling to sci‑fi fans and alluring to investors is that the AI revolution is truly happening. In just three years its assistant Claude has gone from a clunky chatbot to a system that can write code, perform complex tasks and solve previously intractable math problems, ranking at or near the top on all major AI benchmarks.
In a January essay Amodei wrote that at this development pace, “in just a few years AI will surpass humans in almost every domain.”

items.title: 美債跌勢難止！10年期殖利率逼近5% Fed升息也難壓
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Decline Hard to Halt! 10-Year Yield Nears 5% as Fed Hikes Struggle to Contain
paras: 美聯儲近期再次升息, 卻可能仍難以扭轉美國國債市場遭遇的拋售壓力。市場分析指出, 此輪美債殖利率上升的核心原因並非單純通膨升溫, 而是美國經濟成長強勁、政府債務規模龐大、企業債券供給增加, 加上投資人對長期利率維持高檔的預期。這意味著, 即使美聯儲最終成功壓低通膨, 長天期美債殖利率仍可能維持在相對高位。
以iShares 20年期以上美國國債ETF(TLT)為衡量指標, 長天期美債今年以總報酬計算已下跌4.4%, 而且大部分跌幅集中在夏季。與此同時, 美國基準10年期國債殖利率近期升破5%, 9月16日一度觸及5.003%, 創2007年7月以來新高, 顯示長端利率受到的壓力已超出一般貨幣政策週期的影響。
值得注意的是, 通膨預期本身並未出現與殖利率相匹配的升幅。衡量市場未來通膨預期的10年期損益平衡通膨率, 今年截至原文所述周三僅上升約0.09個百分點, 但10年期美債殖利率卻上升接近1個百分點, 升至約5.02%。這代表殖利率上升的主要來源是「實質殖利率」走高, 也就是扣除通膨預期後的利率部分。
這項變化一方面顯示投資人仍相信長期通膨有機會受到控制, 另一方面也反映市場對美國實質經濟成長、資本需求及政府融資需求的評估正在改變。因此, 即使美聯儲透過升息壓低通膨, 也不代表長天期殖利率一定會同步下降。
伯恩斯坦私人財富管理高級投資策略師馬修・帕拉佐洛(Matthew Palazzolo)表示, 如果美聯儲沒有在本周採取行動, 市場很可能會開始計入更高的通膨預期, 進而推升美債殖利率至高於近期的水準。他指出, 當前利率上升主要由經濟成長加快所推動, 而不是通膨預期升高, 人工智慧(AI)相關投資與生產力預期也進一步推高市場對經濟成長的看法。
在這種情況下, 美聯儲的升息雖然可以直接影響短期利率, 卻不一定能控制長期債券殖利率。美聯儲9月16日宣布升息25個基點, 這是2023年以來首次升息, 聯邦基金利率目標區間升至3.75%至4%。聯準會同時釋放進一步收緊政策的訊號, 市場也開始評估今年稍後是否還會有額外升息。
然而, 升息消息並沒有立即讓長天期美債殖利率明顯回落。決策公布後, 10年期殖利率反而一度升至約5.01%, 再創19年高點附近, 隨後才出現部分回落。9月18日, 10年期殖利率再次逼近5%關卡, 收盤附近約為4.996%, 顯示市場對長期利率的壓力仍未消失。
除了經濟成長預期升溫之外, 美國政府龐大的債務需求也是推高長端殖利率的重要因素。美國政府需要持續發行大量國債來為財政赤字與既有債務再融資, 當市場需要吸收的長天期債券增加時, 投資人可能要求更高殖利率作為持有這些債券的補償。
企業債券供給同樣增加了市場對長期資金的競爭。摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase, JPM-US)資料顯示, 2026年以來財務狀況穩健企業發行的債券中, 10年期以上品種占比約18%, 高於2025年的12%。企業愈傾向鎖定長天期資金, 就愈可能與美國財政部在相同的投資人資金池中競爭, 進一步增加長端殖利率的壓力。
企業債券供給增加的背景, 也與人工智慧投資熱潮有關。AI資料中心、電力、半導體及相關基礎設施需要大量資本支出, 部分企業因此透過債券市場籌措長期資金。市場在評估這些投資可能帶來更高生產力與經濟成長的同時, 也必須消化更多企業債券供給。
美國財政政策則是另一個關鍵變數。財政部長史考特・貝森特(Scott Bessent)8月20日接受CNBC訪問時, 以及本周二在國會作證時, 曾暗示政府可能提出一項「財政整頓」計畫, 但截至目前具體方案仍未公布。對債券投資人而言, 單純提出財政整頓方向並不足以改變市場預期, 市場仍需要看到具有可信度且能有效控制政府債務增長的具體措施。
美國財政部近期也已擴大長天期國債回購操作, 試圖改善長端市場流動性。9月初, 財政部宣布將回購10年至20年期國債的規模提高至60億美元, 是前一次長天期回購規模的3倍, 但市場對措施的規模仍存在不同期待。
從全球市場來看, 美國長債殖利率上升也並非孤立現象。德國10年期公債殖利率與日本政府公債殖利率近期同樣處於多年高檔, 顯示全球債券市場正面臨更高的通膨、財政融資及資本需求壓力。
因此, 市場目前面臨的問題已不只是「美聯儲會不會升息」, 而是長期資金成本究竟能否回到過去十多年相對低利率的環境。若美國經濟持續保持韌性, AI投資進一步推升成長預期, 同時政府與企業持續大量發債, 長天期美債殖利率就可能維持在高檔。
相反地, 若經濟成長明顯放緩, 投資人重新增加對安全資產的需求, 或美國政府推出市場認為可信的財政整頓措施, 才可能對長天期美債形成較持久的支撐。
因此, 即使美聯儲已透過升息向市場表明抑制通膨的政策立場, 貨幣政策能夠直接控制的仍主要是短期利率。只要經濟成長、財政赤字、企業融資與長期資本需求持續推高實質殖利率, 美聯儲就很難單靠升息或其他貨幣政策工具, 將長天期美債殖利率重新壓回較低水準。
paras_en: The Fed’s recent rate hike may still fail to reverse the selling pressure hitting the U.S. Treasury market. Analysts say the core driver of the current rally in Treasury yields is not simply hotter inflation, but strong U.S. economic growth, a massive government debt load, increased corporate bond supply, and investors’ expectation that long‑term rates will stay elevated. This means that even if the Fed eventually succeeds in lowering inflation, long‑dated Treasury yields could remain relatively high.

Using the iShares 20‑Year Plus Treasury ETF (TLT) as a gauge, long‑dated U.S. Treasuries have fallen 4.4% in total return so far this year, with most of the loss concentrated in the summer. At the same time, the benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield has recently broken the 5% mark, briefly hitting 5.003% on September 16 – a peak not seen since July 2007 – indicating that pressure on the long end has exceeded the influence of a typical monetary‑policy cycle.

It is noteworthy that inflation expectations have not risen in step with yields. The 10‑year breakeven inflation rate, a measure of market‑expected future inflation, has risen only about 0.09 percentage points this year up to the Wednesday referenced in the article, while the 10‑year Treasury yield has climbed nearly 1 percentage point to around 5.02%. This shows that the bulk of the yield increase is coming from a higher “real yield,” i.e., the return after stripping out expected inflation.

This shift suggests investors still believe long‑term inflation can be tamed, while also reflecting a changing assessment of U.S. real economic growth, capital demand and government financing needs. Consequently, even if the Fed’s rate hikes curb inflation, long‑dated yields are not guaranteed to fall in tandem.

Matthew Palazzolo, senior investment strategist at Bernstein Private Wealth Management, warned that if the Fed does not act this week, markets are likely to start pricing in higher inflation expectations, pushing Treasury yields above recent levels. He noted that the current rate rise is driven mainly by accelerating economic growth rather than rising inflation expectations, and that AI‑related investments and productivity outlooks are further boosting growth expectations.

In this context, the Fed’s hikes can directly affect short‑term rates but do not necessarily control long‑term bond yields. On September 16 the Fed announced a 25‑basis‑point increase – the first hike since 2023 – moving the federal‑funds target range to 3.75%‑4.00%. The central bank also signaled that tighter policy could continue, prompting markets to assess whether additional hikes are likely later this year.

However, the hike did not immediately pull long‑dated yields lower. After the decision, the 10‑year yield actually rose to about 5.01%, near a 19‑year high, before modestly retreating. On September 18 the 10‑year again approached the 5% threshold, closing near 4.996%, showing that pressure on long‑term rates remains unabated.

Beyond hotter growth expectations, the sheer size of U.S. government debt is a key factor pushing up long‑end yields. The Treasury must continuously issue large amounts of debt to fund deficits and refinance existing obligations; as the supply of long‑dated bonds grows, investors may demand higher yields as compensation for holding them.

Corporate bond supply is also adding competition for long‑term capital. JPMorgan Chase data show that, since 2026, bonds issued by financially sound companies with maturities over 10 years account for about 18% of issuance, up from 12% in 2025. The more companies lock in long‑dated funding, the more they compete with the Treasury for the same pool of investor capital, further pressuring long‑end yields.

The increase in corporate bond supply is tied to the AI investment boom. AI data centers, power, semiconductors and related infrastructure require massive capex, leading some firms to raise long‑term funds through the bond market. As markets evaluate the potential productivity and growth gains from these investments, they also have to absorb the additional corporate bond supply.

U.S. fiscal policy is another critical variable. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hinted in a CNBC interview on August 20 and in testimony before Congress this week that the administration may propose a “fiscal consolidation” plan, though no concrete details have been released yet. For bond investors, merely signaling a fiscal adjustment is insufficient to shift market expectations; credible, effective measures to curb debt growth are still needed.

The Treasury has recently expanded its long‑dated bond buyback program to improve liquidity at the long end. In early September it announced that purchases of 10‑ to 20‑year Treasuries would increase to $6 billion, three times the size of the previous program, though market participants have varied expectations about the impact of the larger operation.

Globally, rising U.S. long‑term yields are not an isolated phenomenon. Germany’s 10‑year bund yield and Japan’s government bond yields have also climbed to multi‑year highs, indicating that bond markets worldwide are facing heightened inflation, fiscal financing and capital‑demand pressures.

Thus, the market’s current concern is no longer just “Will the Fed hike again?” but whether long‑term funding costs can ever return to the relatively low‑rate environment of the past decade. If the U.S. economy stays resilient, AI‑driven growth expectations stay high, and both government and corporations continue issuing large amounts of debt, long‑dated Treasury yields are likely to remain elevated.

Conversely, a clear slowdown in economic growth, a renewed shift toward safe‑haven assets, or credible fiscal‑consolidation measures from the government could provide more durable support for long‑dated Treasuries.

Therefore, even though the Fed has signaled its anti‑inflation stance through rate hikes, monetary policy primarily controls short‑term rates. As long as economic growth, fiscal deficits, corporate financing and long‑term capital demand keep pushing real yields higher, the Fed will find it difficult to bring long‑dated Treasury yields back down solely with rate hikes or other monetary tools.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元維持逾7周高點 Fed立場偏鷹
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Friday (the 18th), but boosted by the Federal Reserve’s rate hike it delivered its best weekly performance in three months this week. Meanwhile, market focus shifted to the weakening yen. The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31‑year high, but markets judged the size of the hike and subsequent policy signals as insufficiently aggressive, sending the yen lower.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 100.22. The index is up about 1.1% for the week, marking its strongest weekly gain since mid‑June.

The week’s market focus centered on central‑bank rate hikes. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on Wednesday to raise the federal funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%. In addition, the updated Summary of Economic Projections and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s post‑decision press conference both conveyed a clearly hawkish tone.
Ahead of the FOMC announcement, market expectations for a Fed hike briefly spiked to 90%, driven mainly by soaring oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling pressure.

Fixed‑income investors welcomed the rate‑hike decision, seeing it as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation, which pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher on Thursday. However, yields rose again on Friday, with the 10‑year Treasury yield climbing 6.1 basis points to 5.008%. Earlier in the week the yield had surged to a 19‑year high.
Torres of Interactive Brokers said the latest wave of Treasury‑yield gains is linked to the yen’s decline.

He explained, “A weaker yen creates resistance for U.S. Treasuries because Tokyo is the largest overseas holder of U.S. government debt. A falling yen will gradually force Japanese authorities to sell Treasuries to raise cash for foreign‑exchange intervention, thereby supporting the yen.”
The Bank of Japan is seen as insufficiently hawkish
The BOJ lifted its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. The move was broadly expected as Japan faces a double squeeze of a weak yen and soaring energy costs.

Generally, higher rates tend to support currency appreciation. This time, however, the hike did not lift Japanese assets and instead sparked profit‑taking in the FX market. Investors had hoped the BOJ would adopt a more aggressive tightening path, but two board members opposed the move, voting to keep rates unchanged, which softened the central bank’s hawkish stance and lowered expectations for rapid further tightening.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said after the decision that the action was taken pre‑emptively to avoid having to resort to drastic measures later, but he stressed the bank has not considered adopting an aggressive monetary‑policy shock approach.

Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers noted, “Even though Governor Ueda said he would support further hikes if needed, the opposition of two policymakers to yesterday’s hike has led some investors to question whether the BOJ is truly committed to aggressive tightening if inflation does not cool, contributing to the yen’s slide to a two‑week low against the dollar.”

Later on Friday, the yen briefly reclaimed part of its losses after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had conducted a so‑called rate check – contacting FX market participants to gauge current exchange‑rate levels. Markets usually view a rate check as a preliminary step before possible foreign‑exchange intervention.
Since the start of the year, Japanese authorities have deployed more than ¥15 trillion (about $95.7 billion) to support the yen.
The yen fell to ¥158.05 per dollar on Friday before partially recovering, climbing back up to a high of ¥155.88. The week marked its worst performance since October 2025.

items.title: 川普宣布達格陵蘭協議 將大規模駐軍並獲「永久安全控制權」
items.title_en: Trump Announces Greenland Deal, Will Deploy Large Troops and Claim "Permanent Security Control"
paras: 《CNBC》報導，美國總統川普週五 (18 日) 宣布，美國已與格陵蘭及丹麥達成安全協議，將在格陵蘭適當地點建立大規模軍事部署，並取得他所稱的「永久安全控制權」。不過，格陵蘭與丹麥尚未證實協議已經達成，相關正式文本也尚未公布。
川普在自家社群平台 Truth Social 發文表示，美國將立即啟動程序，在格陵蘭合適地區擴大軍事存在。他聲稱，這項安排涵蓋美國所有關切，且不會讓美國承擔任何費用。
根據川普說法，協議將讓美國永久掌控格陵蘭的安全及其他需求。但從目前披露的內容來看，這項安排與他先前主張將格陵蘭納入美國領土的立場仍有明顯差距。
格陵蘭是丹麥自治領地，美國早已依據與丹麥簽訂的數十年期防務協議，在當地部署軍事力量。格陵蘭政府先前一再強調該島「非賣品」，歐盟今年稍早也曾聯合反對川普收購格陵蘭的主張。
儘管如此，川普對新協議表示滿意，稱相關安排已解決美國的全部關切。
截稿前，格陵蘭與丹麥均未立即回應川普的說法。
paras_en: CNBC reported that U.S. President Donald Trump announced on Friday (the 18th) that the United States has reached a security agreement with Greenland and Denmark to establish a large‑scale military deployment at appropriate locations in Greenland and to obtain what he calls "permanent security control." However, Greenland and Denmark have not confirmed that an agreement has been reached, and the official text has not been released.

Trump posted on his own social platform, Truth Social, that the United States will immediately begin procedures to expand its military presence in suitable areas of Greenland. He claimed the arrangement covers all U.S. concerns and will not cost the United States anything.

According to Trump, the agreement will give the United States permanent control over Greenland’s security and other needs. But based on the limited details disclosed so far, the arrangement still falls short of his earlier stance of annexing Greenland as U.S. territory.

Greenland is an autonomous territory of Denmark, and the United States has long deployed forces there under a multi‑decade defense pact with Denmark. The Greenlandic government has repeatedly stressed that the island is "not for sale," and the European Union earlier this year jointly opposed Trump’s proposal to purchase Greenland.
Nevertheless, Trump said he was satisfied with the new agreement, stating that the arrangement resolves all of America’s concerns.
At the time of submission, neither Greenland nor Denmark had responded immediately to Trump’s statements.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: Four-Quarter Day Volatility, Chip Stocks Support, Philly Semiconductor Index Up Nearly 3%, Dow Weekly Decline Largest in Six Months
paras: 美股週五 (18 日) 漲跌互見，人工智慧 (AI) 題材仍具動能，帶動標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數小幅收高，費半指數高升近3%。道瓊則下跌近百點，10 年期美債殖利率重返 5% 附近，加上國際油價仍處每桶 100 美元以上，持續壓抑市場風險偏好。
那斯達克指數本週上漲約 0.7%，標普 500 指數下跌約 0.1%。道瓊則重挫約 1.7%，寫下 3 月以來最大單週跌幅。
美股週五適逢衍生性金融商品到期的「四巫日」，約有名目價值 7 兆美元的選擇權到期，推升成交量並加劇盤中波動。不過，美債殖利率再度攀升，壓抑美股進一步上攻。
10 年期美債殖利率週五一度升約 5.9 個基點至 5.006%，收在 4.995%。交易員提高 Fed 10 月再次升息的押注，反映市場仍擔憂能源價格上漲可能讓通膨持續承壓。
Fed 本週以 12 比 0 一致通過升息 1 碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至 3.75% 至 4%，為逾 3 年來首次升息。Fed 最新經濟預測與主席華許的談話均顯示，央行仍把抑制通膨列為政策重點。
國際油價週五連續第三個交易日下降，但仍維持在每桶 100 美元以上。市場預期沙烏地阿拉伯可能在數日內恢復東西向輸油管線約一半運能，緩解供應中斷疑慮。沙國也透過阿曼蘇哈爾港外的船對船轉運，向亞洲煉油商提供額外原油。
美伊外交進展也受到關注。美國總統川普本週表示，希望戰爭已接近尾聲，並稱伊朗非常希望達成協議。美國國務院據傳已向伊朗總統及外交部長等官員核發簽證，讓他們出席下週在紐約舉行的聯合國大會。
美股週五 (18 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 2.43%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 0.26%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.64%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 0.80%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 1.00%。

記憶體類股全線走揚。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 3.92%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 4.13%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 大漲 10.99%；希捷 (STX-US) 強漲 6.93%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 上漲 2.46%。

企業新聞
波克夏·海瑟威董事長巴菲特將卸下董事長職務，由其子霍華德·巴菲特接任，為這家綜合企業長達 60 多年的巴菲特時代再畫下一個句點。巴菲特將轉任榮譽董事長並繼續擔任董事。波克夏·海瑟威 B 股 (BRK.B-US) 上漲 0.1% 至每股 509.77 美元。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收低 0.26% 至每股 336.13 美元，週線收高0.57%。iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max週五在台灣及全球多個國家與地區正式開賣，這是特納斯接任執行長後推出的首批新款iPhone。受到AI需求推升全球記憶體與儲存裝置成本影響，兩款Pro機型起售價均較前代調高100美元，分別為1,199美元及1,299美元。
Steel Dynamics (STLD-US) 與紐柯鋼鐵 (NUE-US) 分別下跌 4.11%和 6.32%。儘管美國鋼價過去 12 個月大幅上漲，兩家公司公布的會計年度第三季財測仍令華爾街失望。
Netflix (NFLX-US) 下跌 4.7%，收每股 71.79 美元。富國銀行以用戶參與度下降、缺乏大型原創影集為由，將 Netflix 投資評等調降至「減碼」，並把目標價由 80 美元下修至 57 美元，成為數月來首家看空該公司的券商。
隨著比特幣價格反彈，加密貨幣交易所 Coinbase (COIN-US) 暴漲近 12%，網路交易平台 Robinhood (HOOD-US) 飛升 9.12%，加密資產投資公司 Strategy (MSTR-US) 更飆升逾 16%。投資人未受聯準會 (Fed) 升息及《CLARITY法案》功敗垂成影響。
外媒報導，人工智慧新創公司 Anthropic 已告知投資人，預計今年底前取得約 5 GW 的運算能力，在推進首次公開募股 (IPO) 計畫之際加快擴張腳步。
華爾街分析
Edward Jones 高級投資策略師 Angelo Kourkafas 表示，Fed 最新升息不太可能是一次性行動，但也不像新一輪激進升息週期的開端。在他看來，Fed 目前並未像 2022 年那樣嚴重落後於通膨情勢。
摩根大通執行長戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 對通膨前景保持謹慎，表示目前仍無法確定通膨是否已受到控制，凸顯市場對一次升息能否有效壓低物價仍存疑慮。
Janney Montgomery Scott 投資長 Mark Luschini 表示，距離財報季仍有一段時間，Fed政策前景也已較為明朗，市場目前缺乏推動股市再創新高的新催化劑。若美國與伊朗關係緩和並帶動油價持續回落，則可能降低能源成本的外溢效應與地緣政治風險溢價，成為股市短期上漲動力。
Certuity 投資長 Scott Welch 預期 Fed 可能在 10 月或選舉後至少再升息一次，2027 年也可能再升息一至兩次。美債殖利率仍面臨上行壓力，油價未來幾個月也可能維持高檔。雖然他並未看空股市，但預期市場今年剩餘時間可能維持緩步前進的格局。

paras_en: U.S. stocks on Friday (the 18th) were mixed, with AI themes still providing momentum, nudging the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indices slightly higher while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged almost 3%. The Dow slipped close to 100 points as the 10‑year Treasury yield returned to around 5% and international oil prices stayed above $100 a barrel, continuing to suppress market risk appetite.
The Nasdaq rose about 0.7% this week, the S&P 500 fell roughly 0.1%, and the Dow plunged about 1.7%, marking its biggest weekly drop since March.

Friday’s market coincided with the “quadruple‑witching” day when derivative contracts expire, with about $7 trillion of options expiring, boosting volume and heightening intraday swings. However, rising Treasury yields dampened further upside in U.S. equities.

The 10‑year Treasury yield spiked to about 5.006% on Friday, up roughly 5.9 basis points, before closing at 4.995%. Traders increased bets that the Fed will raise rates again in October, reflecting lingering worries that higher energy prices could keep inflation pressure alive.

The Fed this week unanimously voted 12‑0 to raise its target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4%, its first hike in more than three years. The latest Fed economic forecasts and Chair Powell’s remarks both underscore that curbing inflation remains the central policy focus.

International oil prices fell for the third consecutive trading day on Friday but stayed above $100 a barrel. Markets expect Saudi Arabia may restore about half the capacity of its east‑west pipelines within days, easing supply‑disruption concerns, and the kingdom is also using ship‑to‑ship transfers off Oman’s Suhar port to supply extra crude to Asian refiners.

U.S.–Iran diplomatic developments also drew attention. President Trump said this week he hopes the war is nearing its end and claimed Iran is eager to reach an agreement. Reports say the State Department has issued visas to Iran’s president and foreign minister so they can attend next week’s UN General Assembly in New York.
U.S. market performance on Friday (the 18th):

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 95.40 points, or 0.18%, to 51,682.64. The Nasdaq gained 104.25 points, or 0.40%, to 26,522.55. The S&P 500 rose 12.74 points, or 0.17%, to 7,650.50. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 322.19 points, or 2.78%, to 11,921.69. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 28.19 points, or 0.15%, to 18,806.08.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, performance was mixed: Meta (META‑US) down 2.43%; Apple (AAPL‑US) down 0.26%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) up 0.64%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) down 0.80%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) up 1.00%.

The Philadelphia semiconductor group posted broad gains: AMD (AMD‑US) up 2.70%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) up 2.97%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) up 1.34%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) surged 6.51%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) plunged 5.82%.
Memory stocks rallied across the board: Micron (MU‑US) up 3.92%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) up 4.13%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) surged 10.99%; Seagate (STX‑US) jumped 6.93%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) up 2.46%.
All Taiwan ADRs closed higher: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) up 1.02%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 4.10%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 0.57%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 0.39%.
Corporate news

Berkshire Hathaway’s chairman Warren Buffett will step down as chairman, with his son Howard Buffett taking over, marking the end of the Buffett era at the conglomerate after more than 60 years. Warren will become executive chairman and remain on the board. Berkshire Hathaway B shares (BRK.B‑US) rose 0.1% to $509.77.

Apple (AAPL‑US) fell 0.26% to $336.13, while the weekly chart was up 0.57%. The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max went on sale Friday in Taiwan and many other markets, the first new iPhone models launched under CEO Tony Fadell. Due to AI‑driven demand raising global memory and storage costs, both Pro models start $100 higher than their predecessors, at $1,199 and $1,299 respectively.

Steel Dynamics (STLD‑US) and Nucor (NUE‑US) fell 4.11% and 6.32% respectively. Despite a sharp rise in U.S. steel prices over the past year, the third‑quarter fiscal‑year outlooks from both companies disappointed Wall Street.

Netflix (NFLX‑US) dropped 4.7% to $71.79. Wells Fargo downgraded Netflix to “underweight,” citing declining user engagement and a lack of major original series, cutting the price target from $80 to $57, making it the first bearish rating on the stock in months.

As Bitcoin rebounded, cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase (COIN‑US) surged nearly 12%, trading platform Robinhood (HOOD‑US) jumped 9.12%, and crypto‑investment firm MicroStrategy (MSTR‑US) rose over 16%. Investors appear unfazed by the Fed’s rate hikes and the stalled CLARITY Act.
Foreign media reported that AI startup Anthropic told investors it expects to secure about 5 GW of compute capacity by year‑end, accelerating its expansion as it prepares for an IPO.
Wall Street analysis

Edward Jones senior investment strategist Angelo Kourkafas said the Fed’s latest hike is unlikely to be a one‑off move, but it also does not signal the start of a new aggressive‑tightening cycle. He believes the Fed is not as far behind inflation as it was in 2022.

JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon remains cautious on inflation, saying it is still unclear whether price pressures are truly under control, highlighting market doubts about the effectiveness of a single rate hike in lowering inflation.

Janney Montgomery Scott CIO Mark Luschini noted that earnings season is still some way off and the Fed policy outlook is clearer, leaving the market without a fresh catalyst to push stocks to new highs. He added that a de‑escalation in U.S.–Iran tensions and a continued decline in oil prices could reduce energy‑cost spillovers and geopolitical risk premiums, providing short‑term upside for equities.

Certainty CIO Scott Welch expects the Fed may raise rates again in October or at least once after the election, and possibly one or two more times in 2027. Treasury yields still face upside pressure and oil prices may stay elevated for months. While he is not bearish on equities, he foresees a modest, gradual market trajectory for the remainder of the year.
